'''Jaleit Nall''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] saleswoman who worked aboard [[Carrick Station]] during the ongoing conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

She shared her surname<ref name="TOR" /> with that of [[Janice Nall]], a Twi'lek saleswoman active on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>
